Nuevo Laredo is getting ready for its biggest shopping week of the year. The city's Chamber of Commerce, Canaco, announced that El Buen Fin will run from November 13 to 17, with the kickoff at Plaza Paseo Monterrey, located at Avenida Monterrey and Municipio Libre, according to Manifiesto Tamaulipas.

Businesses that want to take part must register online through the Chamber's platform at buenfin.com, not at the organization's offices. Former Canaco president Eliud Ciénega Jurado said the platform is already running and urged businesses to register on time with their logo so they can begin promoting their offers.

The goal for this year, organizers said during the press conference, is to support local commerce and the city's micro and small businesses, so residents know what businesses exist in the city and take advantage of the offers and promotions during the week.

Organizers recommended that shoppers organize their money to take advantage of the offers at participating businesses throughout the week. Ciénega stressed that shoppers should not forget the real purpose of the program: strengthening local commerce and helping businesses move products that have been sitting unsold for lack of buyers.

El Buen Fin began in Nuevo Laredo through the Chamber of Commerce as a local answer to Black Friday in the United States, which falls on November 27 this year, the day after Thanksgiving. Another goal of the program is to bring informal businesses closer to the Chamber so they can join the formal economy and gain the benefits that formal commerce offers.

Source: Manifiesto Tamaulipas, November 7, 2026.

title: El Buen Fin returns to Nuevo Laredo November 13–17 — Canaco kicks off the shopping week at Plaza Paseo Monterrey
